Definition: from G1380; properly, acceptable (current after assayal), i.e. approved:--approved, tried.
BiblicalUsage: Approved, the metal that has passed the assay, the workman who needs not to be ashamed. Paul greets Apelles, approved in Christ, and tells Timothy to study to show himself approved unto God. James blesses the man who endures temptation, for when he is tried he shall receive the crown of life.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe approval from God is the only approval that finally counts, and it comes to the one who endures the trial rather than the one who avoids it. My aim is to stand before Him as a workman who has handled the word rightly.
